audit.why: 52.53% WR over 5825 games; even-to-Syndra lane — his QQ out-ranges early, her E stun-punish and burst own the mid-lane windows. EVEN 5.5/10 consistent.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full sides read Skill on rows 2,3,5,6 while content win[] reads Syndra there — layers disagreed on four rows. Content whys and the packet levelChart (Skill,Skill,Syndra x5) both back Syndra from level 3 on.
audit.why: From 3, E Scatter the Weak punishes his long, dashless casts; by 6 QE into R kills an immobile mage; item spikes extend it. Rows 0-1 stay Skill on both layers — untouched.
audit.corrected: Full sides rows 2,3,5,6 moved Skill -> Syndra with Hwei-specific whys in the same atomic group; win[] already correct so side edits alone.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer names his CC palette 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' in eleven fields — fabricated; the real ability is Subject: Torment (E, 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s). Content wants.you[1] cites 'his EE Stirring Lands' — Stirring Lights is a W-palette spell and the EE root is Gaze of the Abyss; wants.foe[1]'s 'WW slow pool' misassigns the slow. breakdown.cooldowns had no digits. Missing interaction: Subject: Serenity (W, 18s) shields — force it before committing burst.
audit.why: Kit file is authoritative on names; packet defect note confirms no real Hwei ability was ever named.
audit.corrected: All 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' occurrences replaced with Subject: Torment (E); sub-spell fabrications replaced with kit-listed names (Gaze of the Abyss, Molten Fissure); cooldown numbers and the W-shield rule added.

notes: Eleven full-layer fields carried the fabricated 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' — all swapped to Subject: Torment (E), matching the packet defect note. Content 'EE Stirring Lands' was doubly wrong (Stirring Lights is W-palette; the EE root is Gaze of the Abyss) and 'WW slow pool' misassigned — both replaced with kit-listed sub-spell names only. Chart rows 2,3,5,6 aligned to Syndra (content and packet already agreed); rows 0-1 Skill on both layers, row 4 already agreed. W Serenity shield interaction added to cooldowns and enemyWin. Sub-spell EFFECT details beyond Riot's palette text (e.g. exact Pool of Reflection behaviour) were not asserted anywhere.
